operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The documented conversion of PDB files into biomolecular graph objects is not equivalent to reshaping, partitioning, or projecting values.
Graph convolution/message passing followed by autoencoder encoding is not represented by the catalog's projection or attention primitives.
